settings.introZh: 这里记录我长期体验过的游戏、游玩时长、完成情况与部分设计观察。
settings.introEn: A record of games I have spent meaningful time with, including playtime, completion status, achievements, and selected design observations.
settings.steamNoteZh: Steam 主页用于核对公开的游戏库与游玩时长；本页也包含非 Steam 游戏，因此两边不会完全一致。
settings.steamNoteEn: My public Steam profile can be used to verify library and playtime data. This page also includes non-Steam titles, so the two lists are not expected to match exactly.
